definitions.explanation: The two ears together, as opposed to one ear.

examples.japanese: {両耳|りょうみみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put earphones in both ears.
I covered both ears with my hands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{両耳|りょうみみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{聴力|ちょうりょく}→聴力：05034_chouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was diagnosed with hearing loss in both ears.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧ (both) + ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ (ear). A straightforward compound used in everyday, medical, and product description contexts.

USAGE:
- Common in medical descriptions of hearing conditions
- Used when specifying earphone/hearing aid type
- Contrasts with ⟦{片耳|かたみみ}→片耳：26319_katamimi⟧ (one ear)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {両耳|りょうみみ}⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧: earphones for both ears
- {両耳|りょうみみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{聴力|ちょうりょく}→聴力：05034_chouryoku⟧: hearing in both ears
- {両耳|りょうみみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{澄|す}ます→澄ます：16578_sumasu⟧: to listen carefully with both ears
- {両耳|りょうみみ}⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧{補聴器|ほちょうき}: hearing aids for both ears
